title: Kiritani Haruka — An Idol's Duty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The perfect idol...
Never able to be her usual self...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We have to prepare for whichever path Shizuku ultimately decides to choose...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that's probably enough for dance practice today. Let's start discussing what we'll be doing for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We should do whatever we can right now in order to help Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How does that sound, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Um... Our next stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem really worried about Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Of course she is. It'd be strange if she weren't.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
May I have some time to think this over?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I promise to find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Friends are supposed to be there to lend a hand at times like this, but what can we do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, why don't you go and see Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I completely agree that Shizuku will have to make her own decision...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even so, that doesn't mean she has to bear this burden all by herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...!
You're right, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna go look for her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! That means we'll need to come up with enough ideas for streams to make up for their absence!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, that sounds like a plan.
Let's start by finding some videos to use as reference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, this dance group's video is incredible. Every move is synchronized perfectly, right down to their hand gestures...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They even have a camera filming their feet.
It really adds a lot of value.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They seem to know exactly how to make their dancing look the coolest.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, what do you think about this dance group...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? What...?!
Sorry, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...
You're worried about Shizuku too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Every time I try to come up with an idea, I can't help but come back to something that has to do with getting to know the real Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. But I really shouldn't be since she hasn't even found her answer yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true, but we'll need to come up with different ideas that can work with whatever she decides to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'd still like to hear what you have in mind as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! In that case... Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-H-H-Haruka...! Y-you're so...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? I'm so...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-N-Never mind! I-It's n-n-n-n-nothing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're all red now. You're not coming down with a fever, are you? Here, let me check your temperature...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, I forgot one of my...
Hm? Haruka? What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori looked like she might have a fever, so I was checking her temperature.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?! Are you okay, Minori?!
We should get you to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Waaahhh! N-No, I'm fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just didn't expect Haruka to get so close, and was startled is all...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what was going on?
But I kind of miss those reactions of yours!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You would get so nervous whenever we spoke back when we first met too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course! I mean... You're the idol I've been looking up to all this time, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think my heart is finally starting to get used to the fact I actually know you, but I still get the occasional jolt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sigh... But what am I doing?!
I should be focusing on coming up with ideas,
and helping Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. Try to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...! Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Try not to worry about it so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... Shizuku's having such a hard time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is exactly why I think we should try not to act any differently than we usually do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right. If we start looking all discouraged, Shizuku's gonna think that's her fault too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. The best thing we can do is keep smiling to let her know everything is going to be fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka... Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do my... Gasp!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it this time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I had an idea for a video too,
but I forgot what it was...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pfft... Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...
